name: CHOOZ
summary: CHOOZ was a kilometre-baseline reactor-antineutrino disappearance experiment in the French Ardennes. Its null result strongly limited electron-flavour mixing at the atmospheric mass splitting before the later discovery of a nonzero theta13.
detection_principle: A gadolinium-loaded liquid-scintillator target detects inverse beta decay through prompt positron light and delayed gamma rays from neutron capture on gadolinium. Reactor power changes and shutdown periods constrain backgrounds.
